across complex integrated banking platforms for global financial institutions. Strong expertise in requirements elicitation, stakeholder management, and end-to-end business analysis, translating business needs into clear, actionable requirements. Extensive experience in Agile / Scrum delivery, including user story creation, acceptance criteria definition, backlog refinement, and sprint planning. Proven domain knowledge across in-house banking platforms, Digital, Investment and commercial banking, Everyday Business Banking, and payments lifecycle (ISO20022 and payment transformation initiatives). Experienced in working with external vendors and cross-functional teams to align business requirements, perform gap analysis, and support solution delivery. Strong analytical mindset with hands-on experience in financial calculations, and data analysis. Proficient with JIRA, Confluence, SQL, Excel, Postman, and process-modelling tools. Effective communication between business stakeholders and development teams to ensure a shared understanding of project requirements. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to review story requirements and validate system functionality Create flow diagrams and document technical solutions Continuously learn and adapt to modern technologies, industry best practices, and emerging trends in business analysis and Agile methodologies.

CORE COMPETENCIES/Key Skills

Business Analysis & Requirements Engineering

• Gap analysis • End-to-end journey mapping • User story creation and refinement • Stakeholder management • As-Is and To-Be process flows •

Product Backlog & Feature Prioritization

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Commonwealth Bank, Bengaluru, India

Senior Test/Business Analyst | Nov 2021 – Aug 2025

Essential Functions:

Participated in regular calls with Product Owners to understand functional requirements for user stories and contributed to backlog refinement activities driving prioritization — raising clarifications and updating acceptance criteria to ensure stories were testable and sprint-ready

Collect requirements from stakeholders and transform them into user stories. • Assess potential risks linked to new projects and suggest mitigation strategies to ensure compliance and reduce losses. Facilitate multiple workshop sessions with diverse stakeholders to enhance and clarify requirements.

• Developuser stories with appropriate descriptions and acceptance criteria by decomposing the requirements. Establish Epics and Initiatives, linking them to the corresponding user stories.

• Collaborate with the team during story refinement sessions to enhance the stories and maintain a

•

robust backlog. Examine existing data to uncover trends, patterns, and insights that can guide business decisions. Create comprehensive use cases to illustrate system behaviour and user interactions. For internal use only

Document the details of the initiative in Confluence and ensure they are updated as necessary. 10. Oversee Sprint Planning, Retrospectives, and daily scrum meetings while assuming the role of Scrum Master.

Work alongside technical teams to design solutions that meet both business requirements and



•

technical limitations. Ensure traceability from requirements to testing and delivery, improving quality, reducing rework, and supporting audit and compliance expectations. Engage in the testing phase by reviewing test cases and analyzing results to ensure quality assurance. Executed and supported UAT, system, and end-to-end testing contributing to quality delivery and reduced rework

Use Postman to validate APIs and integration points, and AWS services to support testing, data validation, and environment-level verification.

Manage change requests and evaluate their effects on project timelines and budgets.

Cognizant, Bengaluru & Pune, India

Senior Associate/Associate/Programmer Analyst | Dec 2010 – Nov 2021

Progressed through multiple roles over 11 years, building deep expertise in banking domain analysis, business requirements management, and comprehensive quality assurance across major financial institutions. Successfully delivered critical projects for ANZ Bank, J.P. Morgan Chase, and Royal Bank of Scotland.

Collaborated with business stakeholders and delivery teams to clarify business requirements, validate functional logic, and support solution design discussions.

calculations and regulatory business rules. Supported User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by assisting business users, triaging issues, and ensuring delivered functionality met business expectations.
